nodes.title: SG-3.1 · Complete the typed event bridge
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts already declares PhaserToReactEvents, ReactToPhaserEvents and createEventBus, and App, ObjectOverlay and BootScene use it. Desired behavior: the bridge exposes named types for its maps, payloads and unsubscribe functions, and every consumer is typed through them. Tests cover emit, off, unsubscribe and clear. Expected result: no untyped bridge usage and no change in what the player sees. Why: SG-3.2 and SG-3.3 build the input layer on this bridge.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given events.ts, when it is read, then it exports Unsubscribe, EmptyPayload, PhaserToReactEvents and ReactToPhaserEvents, and every on() returns an Unsubscribe
- Given App, ObjectOverlay and BootScene, when typechecked, then every phaserToReact and reactToPhaser call is typed through the bridge with no casts
- Given the bridge tests, when run, then emit, off, unsubscribe and clear are each asserted
- Given npm test and npm run typecheck, when run in game/ and game/frontend/, then both pass


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts
- In scope: typing of bridge consumers in App, ObjectOverlay and BootScene
- In scope: bridge unit tests
- Out of scope: SG-3.2 input layer module
- Out of scope: SG-3.3 switching BootScene and components to the input layer
- Out of scope: backend/
- Out of scope: new events with no emitter
- Preserve: boys-room gameplay
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin and its guard test
- Preserve: existing tests, none deleted or skipped
- Preserve: api/client.ts endpoints


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No source file over 200 lines
- events.ts stays free of any 'phaser' import
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- All requirements met
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · events.ts exports the full typed maps and an Unsubscribe type
nodes.body:
Context: events.ts uses the inline type Record<string, never> for menuClose and the inline type () => void for unsubscribers. Desired behavior: export type Unsubscribe = () => void and type EmptyPayload = Record<string, never>. EventBus.on returns Unsubscribe and menuClose uses EmptyPayload. Expected result: one named vocabulary for the bridge. Why: later input-layer modules import these names.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given events.ts, when imported, then Unsubscribe and EmptyPayload are exported types
- Given EventBus.on, when called, then its return type is Unsubscribe
- Given the PhaserToReactEvents map, when read, then menuClose has the payload type EmptyPayload
- Given the existing bridge tests, when run, then they still pass

- In scope: events.ts type exports
- Out of scope: runtime behavior changes
- Preserve: event names and payload shapes


## Technical constraints
- No 'phaser' import in events.ts
- Phaser ~3.90.0 pin

nodes.title: REQ · Every bridge consumer is typed through the exported names
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene declares unsubscribe fields as (() => void) | null, and ObjectOverlay emits menuClose with a literal {}. Desired behavior: BootScene fields are typed Unsubscribe | null and the menuClose emitters pass an EmptyPayload-typed value. Expected result: all bridge usage goes through the typed names, with identical behavior. Why: the intent requires every bridge use to be typed.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene, when read, then unsubscribe, unsubscribeAnimation and unsubscribeTransition are typed Unsubscribe | null
- Given ObjectOverlay and BootScene, when typechecked, then menuClose is emitted with an EmptyPayload value
- Given the source tree, when scanned, then phaserToReact and reactToPhaser are the only emitters of bridge events
- Given BootScene shutdown, when it runs, then every subscription is still released


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene.ts unsubscribe field types
- In scope: ObjectOverlay.tsx menuClose emit
- In scope: BootScene.ts menuClose emit
- Out of scope: input layer extraction
- Preserve: shutdown cleanup order
- Preserve: Escape closes the menu

- BootScene.ts under 200 lines
- Phaser ~3.90.0 pin


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- No inline (() => void) unsubscribe types remain in BootScene

nodes.title: REQ · Bridge tests cover emit, off, unsubscribe, clear and isolation
nodes.body:
Context: tests/phaserEvents.test.ts covers emit, unsubscribe and clear but not off(), emit with no handlers, multiple handlers, unsubscribing during emit, or isolation between the two buses. Desired behavior: add those cases, written against behavior. Expected result: every bus operation is proven by a unit test. Why: the Done-when asks for tests of emit, unsubscribe and clear.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a handler, when off() is called with it, then later emits do not reach it
- Given no handlers, when emit is called, then nothing throws
- Given two handlers on one event, when emitted, then both receive the payload
- Given a handler that unsubscribes itself during emit, when emitted, then the other handlers on that dispatch still run
- Given a handler on phaserToReact, when reactToPhaser emits, then it is not called


## Scope
- In scope: tests/phaserEvents.test.ts additions
- Out of scope: product code changes
- Preserve: existing tests untouched


## Technical constraints
- Tests mock nothing internal
- Phaser ~3.90.0 pin


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- New tests pass alongside the existing ones


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Make EventBus.off and emit robust for the bridge tests
nodes.body:
The bus already snapshots handlers on emit and ignores an off() for an unknown handler. This Act only adds a comment documenting that contract above createEventBus so the tests have a spec.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given events.ts, when read, then the createEventBus contract comment states the snapshot dispatch and the idempotent off
- Given the bus, when behavior is compared before and after, then it is unchanged

steps.action: Add a doc comment above createEventBus stating: handlers run in subscription order against a snapshot, so a handler may unsubscribe during emit; off() for an unknown handler is a no-op; clear() drops every handler.
